source_revision_conditions_verbatim.joint: T2 source controls and field interpretation
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.finding: The source states neither the representation level of support nor nontriviality. A solver-level reading preserves support in the actual F2 ring and has only the identity coefficient vector. The pre-descent K12 option is a different, explicitly declared matching object and may change the F2 support/degree pattern being measured. No mathematical argument uniquely identifies that option as the original source intention.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.required_change: Before implementation, separately bind an additive scientific clarification that declares the support level, randomized coefficient field, chart-count predicates and consequent claim scope. The concrete already-described option is K12-support matching with both per-chart counts, explicitly permitting changed descended F2 supports; retain the 18 F2 identity slots, 18 interpretation slots and 18 supplemental K12 slots and every failed search. If exact realized-F2 support is required instead, record that its coefficient law is degenerate and admit a separately specified discriminating control before controlled scientific inference. Do not call the source literally nontrivial or realized-F2.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.not_claimed: No impossibility or negative evidence for h-torsion acceleration; no choice after outcomes; no authorization from this review.

source_revision_conditions_verbatim.joint: T3 complete panel, formulas and recovery
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.finding: Removing O-chart tagged roots need not remove any recovered signed decomposition after projection to core coordinates and enumeration of every lift. For an allowed abstract ordinary subgroup point P and R=P, core (a,a,a), a=x(P), has the finite-chart root u=x(2P) as well as the O root. The finite projection still lets the stated recovery enumerate (P,-P,P). Thus the specified expected signed-recovery loss is not a guaranteed wrong-chart discriminator.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.required_change: Bind the mutation to independent equality of the full tagged root domain, which the general protocol already requires: deleting any existing O-chart tag must fail that check even if projected or signed solution sets coincide. Explicitly verify that the chosen synthetic fixture has an O root. If the control is intended to prove loss of a decomposition specifically, preregister and justify an additional witness with no finite-chart core coverage; do not assume the lexicographically first inverse-pair tuple has that property.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.not_claimed: No ordinary point was generated and no curve sweep or experiment was run. The two-chart union remains a sound completeness design; this finding concerns the control expected failure mechanism.

source_revision_conditions_verbatim.joint: T4 full costs, thresholds and fixed policies
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.finding: Primary criteria use field/phase/SAT-status slices without explicitly specifying whether SAT means a nonempty polynomial root domain, either Boolean chart, a projected core domain, or a nonempty recovered subgroup-decomposition set. The specification itself allows algebraic roots without rational subgroup lifts, so these are different predicates and can change both medians and ceil(N/2). Known_SAT/UNSAT fixtures define elementary polynomial controls but do not freeze the target-level aggregation rule.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.required_change: Freeze a literal target-level predicate and stratum key before data, preferably algebraic_SAT iff the original polynomial domain is nonempty (for Boolean targets, the tagged union of both chart domains is nonempty), and report separate chart and recovered_group_SAT flags. Use the frozen ordinary-target assignment for all methods, preserve unknown/incomplete slots without treating them as UNSAT, and state exactly which flag forms N for each primary ratio and H1. Keep 0.75,0.8 and the at-least-half denominator rule unchanged.
source_revision_conditions_verbatim.not_claimed: No denominator was recomputed from runs; none exist. This is a preregistration ambiguity, not evidence of biased measured reporting.
